title: Step 65-E approved-wholesale price/quantity UX integrated with existing Product and Cart authority
description: HIGH-risk Step 65-E. Productionize SF-E-10 across existing Product and Cart flows without a parallel B2B commerce engine. Close the proven CartView presentation gap by enriching the existing Cart response from canonical Pricing + CustomerCommerce + Inventory authority for the cart owner's current customer_type and line quantity. Product public catalog prices remain retail/default and must never be relabeled as wholesale. An authenticated authoritative wholesale customer is attached to the existing customer cart before product add-to-cart so Cart pricing can resolve wholesale server-side. No pricing rule, quantity threshold, discount percentage, Checkout/Order lifecycle, database or dependency change.

dependencies.evidence: PR #334 merged after exact-artifact Project Owner Human Gate; exact-SHA Canonical CI 37980747330, Phase A 37980747282 and Storefront Quality 37980747159 SUCCESS; terminal Lock release comment 6087902230.

audit_findings: Public Catalog getVariantPrice currently calls Pricing with default quantity=1 and customerType=retail; Product price must not be relabeled as wholesale.
Current CartView runtime/OpenAPI exposes identity and quantity only, so Storefront cannot lawfully display numeric wholesale pricing in Cart.
Canonical Cart Quote already resolves cart owner customer_type and quantity through CustomerCommercePort + PricingQuotePort.
CartService already injects CustomerCommercePort, PricingQuotePort and InventoryAvailabilityPort, allowing Cart presentation to reuse the same authorities without a new B2B engine.
SF-E-10 is an embedded wholesale commerce context, not a standalone route.
Frontend hardcoded wholesale minimum quantity is forbidden; governed configuration currently defaults to 11 but is not Storefront authority.

acceptance_criteria.description: CartView contract is enriched only with server-derived customer_type, per-line current quantity pricing/discount/availability and a nullable pricing summary/revalidation flag; generated TypeScript matches OpenAPI exactly.

CartService presentation resolves customer type from cart owner, calls Pricing quoteVariant with each line's authoritative quantity + customerType, calls Inventory availability, uses integer-Toman MoneyToman invariants, and never reads pricing/customer/inventory persistence directly.
Cart remains readable when an item cannot produce a current price: line pricing is null, overall pricing summary is null and requires_revalidation=true; no zero/fabricated price is invented.
Product detail derives customer_type only from current Customer Profile. Public Product/Variant prices remain catalog/default prices and are never labeled as wholesale.

For an authoritative wholesale session, product add-to-cart uses the existing customer Cart authority (merge existing guest cart when valid, otherwise access/create customer cart) and serializes only server-only HttpOnly cart credentials; retail/guest behavior remains supported.

Wholesale Product UX allows a bounded quantity input and explains that authoritative wholesale/quantity price is recalculated in Cart; no frontend minimum threshold, discount formula or guaranteed savings is introduced.

Cart displays authoritative unit/line/subtotal/discount/total Toman data from CartView, non-color wholesale context, availability/low-stock information, and reprices after quantity mutation through the existing Cart action.
No Pricing rule/config, Customer promotion, Inventory rule, Checkout/Reservation/Order, DB, dependency, admin, Product Design or Current-State mutation is introduced.
Inherited Product/Cart/Checkout/API/auth/state/quality verifiers remain in the Storefront verify chain together with the new Step 65-E verifier.

HIGH-risk closure requires exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront Quality, CodeQL/Security, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, exact-artifact Project Owner Human approval, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release.
